description: List all modules in a course, including each module's name, position, publication state, unlock date and item count, but not the items inside. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use `list_module_items` or `get_course_structure` to see what is inside each module, and `get_module` to fetch one module by ID.
name: list_modules
title: List Modules
